answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 9082 Country: Canada Title: Is it permissible for a male to have his hair cut by a ghair-mahram female? Question: Is it permissible for a male to have his hair cut by a ghair-mahram female? Answer ID: 9082 Posted on: Aug 29, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1549/1289=L/1429) It is not allowed for a man to have his hair cur by ghiar-mahram woman. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
